title: A calculation (calculations/<name>.yaml of a solution)
description: Numbers worked out by formulas line by line, as Excel would, with no AI and nothing paid. A line is given by the step that works the calculation out, or worked out by its formula from the lines above it; a formula is written as in Excel with the keys of lines where Excel has cells. With workbook the business's own Excel model works it out instead: each line names its cell, not a formula.

workbook.description: The business's own Excel model, next to solution.yaml

key.description: Such as a year: 2024; or a place, such as a1 or f1, when the periods come from the case

group.description: Such as past or forecast; a line may have a formula per group

cell.description: With a workbook: the header cell that holds this column's period, such as Model!C12. The columns are then places, not periods: each case's numbered periods (such as years) are laid in by its last one, the headers written with them, and the results named by them

columns.description: Columns of lines that have a value per column, such as the years of a forecast

key.description: The name formulas and later steps use: calculation.<key>

given.description: true: the step gives it (in.<key>); otherwise it is worked out by its formula

type.description: For showing it: money, share (0.15 is 15%), times (a multiple), number

formula.description: As in Excel, with the keys of the lines above: price * quantity, IF(...), ROUND(...); with columns also prev, at, last, n, range, sum, avg, npv, irr

cell.description: With a workbook: the cell it is in, such as Valuation!C7

note.description: Where the value comes from, in words

example.description: A value of a given line to try the calculation with

examples.description: With columns: an example per column

columns.description: true: the line has a value per column

groups.description: A formula per group of columns

check.description: true: its formula has to come to zero, such as assets - liabilities - equity

tolerance.description: How far from zero a check may be; 0.01 unless said
